chunks: And from him, from Ali ibn al-Rayyan, he raised it to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The chief of the sauces of the Paradise is the meat (sauce)'.
ai.seo_question: What is the chief sauce in Paradise according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: In Al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this hadith where the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) identifies meat as the 'master of Adam's [delights in] Paradise,' emphasizing its superior status among the culinary pleasures of the afterlife. This narration is central to the Shia tradition regarding the permissibility and virtue of consuming meat, linking earthly sustenance to the refined joys of Jannah. It reflects the holistic Shia view that physical pleasures, when consumed in accordance with divine law, serve as a means of spiritual elevation and reward.

en.hubeali:
And from him, from Ali Bin Al Rayyan, 
(It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The chief of the sauces of the Paradise is the meat (sauce)’.
en.sarwar: 3. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Ali ibn al-Rayyan in a marfu‘ manner has said, the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘The master food in paradise is meat.’”
